name: BD13816STU
description: onsemi BD13816STU, a PNP medium-power transistor in TO-126 (E1, C2, B3): VCEO 60 V, 1.5 A, 12.5 W at 25 C case; hFE group 16: 100 to 250 at 150 mA, at least 25 at 5 mA and 500 mA; VCE(sat) 0.5 V maximum at 0.5 A, VBE(on) 1 V maximum. The model's gain is 158, the middle of the group.

omissions: the gain's fall at low and high current: it stays 158
the Early effect: the collector current does not rise with VCE
capacitances and fT, so no switching times
temperature: VBE's -2 mV/C and the gain's rise
second breakdown, the safe operating area and damage past the ratings

fr.description: onsemi BD13816STU, un transistor de moyenne puissance PNP en TO-126 (E1, C2, B3) : VCEO 60 V, 1,5 A, 12,5 W à 25 °C de boîtier ; groupe de gain 16 : 100 à 250 à 150 mA, au moins 25 à 5 mA et 500 mA ; VCE(sat) de 0,5 V au maximum à 0,5 A, VBE(on) de 1 V au maximum.
